```{r data-read-fredenhagen}
# load data from first study wave
data_freden <- fread(
  "./data/data506.csv",
  na.strings = c("NA", "", "-77", "-66", "-99")
)

# convert missing values in numeric variables
tmp <- c(
  "day",

  "gender",
  "working_hours_per_week",
  "profession",
  "sci1_debt",
  "sci2_moving",

  "abf8_konkurrenz",
  "abf9_krank",
  "abf10_unstimmigkeitkollegen",
  "abf11_laengerarbeit",
  "abf12_leistungunzufrieden",
  "abf13_nichtalleserledigt",

  "panas_p5_aufmerksam",
  "panas_n5_angst",
  "stressed",
  "relaxed",
  "workinghours_daily"
)
data_freden <- data_freden[,
  (tmp) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
    ifelse(x %in% c(-66, -77), NA, x)
  }),
  .SDcols = tmp
]

# set correct timezone
attr(data_freden$datetime, "tzone") <- "Europe/Paris"

# participant identifier variable
data_freden %<>% rename(code = v_3)
data_freden$code <- tolower(data_freden$code) # make code all lowercase to avoid participant errors with casing
data_freden$code <- stringr::str_replace_all(data_freden$code, stringr::fixed(" "), "")
data_freden$code <- stringr::str_replace_all(data_freden$code, stringr::fixed("meincodelautet"), "")

# there are two participants with the code ua01 --> make the one after lfdn 500 to ua01_2
ua01_2 <- data_freden$code == "ua01" & data_freden$lfdn > 500
data_freden$code[ua01_2] <- "ua01-2"

# there are two participants with the code ma08 --> make the one after lfdn 500 to ma08_2
ma08_2 <- data_freden$code == "ma08" & data_freden$lfdn > 500
data_freden$code[ma08_2] <- "ma08-2"

# ai05 did the study twice, remove the one with less measurements
data_freden <- data_freden %>%
  filter(!(code == "ai05" & lfdn < 400))

# de07 did the study twice, remove the one with less measurements
data_freden <- data_freden %>%
  filter(!(code == "de07" & lfdn < 400))

# transform variables and get date and time information from actual date and time to check for inconsistencies with self-reported days
data_freden %<>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("male", "female")),
    profession = factor(profession),
    datetime_dayofweek = wday(datetime),
    datetime_hour = hour(datetime),
    datetime_minute = minute(datetime),
    datetime_standardtime = unclass(datetime)
  )

# add unique identifier to dataframe
data_freden$lfdn <- paste("fredenhagen", data_freden$lfdn, sep = "_")

# initial cleaning of data
data_freden %<>%
  filter(!grepl("test", code)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(day))

# fix inconsistencies in participant codes
## remove test participants
data_freden %<>%
  filter(code != "w5wte") %>%
  filter(code != "123") %>%
  filter(code != "8") %>%
  filter(code != "alex1") %>%
  filter(code != "alex2") %>%
  filter(code != "alex3") %>%
  filter(code != "andone") %>%
  filter(code != "belf") %>%
  filter(code != "fhk") %>%
  filter(code != "hsh") %>%
  filter(code != "pa09")  # test participant

# participant typed in the wrong code, is actually so03
data_freden[code == "so02", code := "so03"]

# save number of participants
meta$missing$whole_sample <- length(unique(data_freden$code))

# correct for further inconsistencies
# add gender information for missings, 1 = male 2 = female
data_freden$gender[data_freden$code == "ci04"] <- "male"
data_freden$gender[data_freden$code == "thelast"] <- "male"
data_freden$gender[data_freden$code == "vl04"] <- "male"
data_freden$gender[data_freden$code == "ma05"] <- "female"
data_freden$gender[data_freden$code == "ma08"] <- "female"

# remove people and measurements with severe inconsistencies
data_freden %<>%
  filter(code != "ae03") %>% # many inconsistencies
  filter(code != "glo29") %>% # did several recordings on the same day
  filter(code != "gu29") %>% # reported several days but did all recordings on one day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_482") %>% # removed because did it on Saturday but said it was Friday
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_76") %>% # did it Tuesday in the morning before work
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_155") %>% # removed because did it on Sunday but said it was Tuesday
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_218") %>% # did it on a random Sunday not in the same week
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_20") %>% # twice Monday
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_49") %>% # twice Monday
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_483") %>% # morning before work
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_299") %>% # twice on Sunday
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_348") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_111") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_126") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_217") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_349") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_231") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_356") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_358") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_138") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_143") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_138") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_265") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_271") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_343") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_357") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_361") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_527") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_106") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_362") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_363") %>% # did it on the wrong day
  filter(lfdn != "fredenhagen_260") # did it on the wrong day

# adapt inconsistencies
ag05_day_8_is_fri <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_134" # participant forgot to choose a day in the questionnaire which is indicated as 8 in the data, it was on Friday
data_freden$day[ag05_day_8_is_fri] <- 6

ar08_sat_is_sun <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_137" # participant did it on Saturday, we count it as Sunday
data_freden$day[ar08_sat_is_sun] <- 7

ma05_7_is_1 <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_64" # indicated wrong self-report day
data_freden$day[ma05_7_is_1] <- 1

ua01_2_wed_is_thu <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_506" # participant reported the day wrong thought it was still Wednesday when they were doing it on Thursday, so two Wednesday but no Thursday measure -> adapt
data_freden$day[ua01_2_wed_is_thu] <- 5

vl04_7_is_1 <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_430" # indicated wrong self report day
data_freden$day[vl04_7_is_1] <- 1

ca01_7_is_1 <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_23" # indicated wrong self-report day
data_freden$day[ca01_7_is_1] <- 1

eu01_friday_is_sunday <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_101" # participant forgot it on Friday, did it on saturday, we count it as sunday
data_freden$day[eu01_friday_is_sunday] <- 7

mu03_6_is_7 <- data_freden$lfdn == "fredenhagen_340" # participant forgot it on Friday, did it on Saturday, we count it as Sunday, because participant did Friday in the night to Saturday
data_freden$day[mu03_6_is_7] <- 7

# write cleaned data
write.csv(data_freden, "./data/test_clean_freden.csv")
```

```{r data-speech-fredenhagen}
# add information from speech analyses excel sheets

# add a column to the csv files that specifies the participant code
## specify a helper function for that
read_csv_filename <- function(filename) {
  ret <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename))
  ret$code <- filename
  ret
}

import_speechdata <- plyr::ldply(list.files("./data/Fredenhagen/allcsv", full.names = T, include.dirs = T), read_csv_filename)

## strip the rest of the filename from the columns to make the code column, then make lowercase
import_speechdata$code <- stringr::str_extract(import_speechdata$code, pattern = "(?<=allcsv/)(.+)(?=_tag)")
# import_speechdata <- select(import_speechdata, -X1)
import_speechdata$code <- tolower(import_speechdata$code)

# write data
write.csv(import_speechdata, "./data/test_speechdata_freden.csv")

# clean and adapt speech data

## add +1 to the days from the second wave as they start with Sunday = 0
subset_secondwave_import_speechdata <- import_speechdata %>% 
  filter(code %in% c(
      "aa07",
      "ae03",
      "ai05",
      "al05",
      "aü05",
      "ce03",
      "ci12",
      "de07",
      "em06",
      "eü06",
      "ga08",
      "ha10",
      "he07",
      "in02",
      "la10",
      "lh11",
      "ma18",
      "mu01",
      "sh05",
      "ua01_2",
      "ua10",
      "vd07",
      "vl04"
    )
  )

subset_firstwave_import_speechdata <- import_speechdata %>%
  anti_join(subset_secondwave_import_speechdata)

subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day <- subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day + 1

## -1 for second Sunday to make Sunday (8) to Sunday (7) and parallel to first wave where there was no Saturday
subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day[subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day == 8] <- subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day[subset_secondwave_import_speechdata$day == 8] - 1

## merge the subsets of the two waves of data collection together again
import_speechdata <- bind_rows(subset_firstwave_import_speechdata, subset_secondwave_import_speechdata)

# write data
write.csv(import_speechdata, "./data/test_speechdata_freden.csv")

## de07 did the study twice, we only use the more recent data
import_speechdata %<>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 1) %>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 3) %>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 4) %>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 5) %>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 6) %>%
  filter(code != "de07" | day != 7)

de07_day1 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 36
import_speechdata$day[de07_day1] <- 1

de07_day2 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 37
import_speechdata$day[de07_day2] <- 2

de07_day3 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 38
import_speechdata$day[de07_day3] <- 3

de07_day4 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 39
import_speechdata$day[de07_day4] <- 4

de07_day5 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 40
import_speechdata$day[de07_day5] <- 5

de07_day7 <- import_speechdata$code == "de07" & import_speechdata$day == 43
import_speechdata$day[de07_day7] <- 7

# eu01 did it on Saturday, recode speech day so it counts as Sunday
eu01_6_is_7 <- import_speechdata$code == "eu01" & import_speechdata$day == 6
import_speechdata$day[eu01_6_is_7] <- 7

# uk02 recode for wrong days
uk02_4_is_3 <- import_speechdata$code == "uk02" & import_speechdata$day == 4
import_speechdata$day[uk02_4_is_3] <- 3
```

```{r data-read-hahne}
data_raw_hahne_kg$lfdn <- paste("kg_hahne", data_raw_hahne_kg$lfdn, sep = "_")

# kö12R is a female who forgot to indicate her gender, replace 3 (no response) with 2(female)

# merge the data sets

  filter(lfdn != "eg_hahne_229") %>% # Thurdsay but said it was Wednesday
```

```{r data-speech-hahne}
############### add information from speech analyses excel sheets

# add a column to the csv files that specifies the participant code
## specify a helper function for that
read_csv_filename <- function(filename) {
  ret <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename))
  ret$code <- filename
  ret
}

import_speechdata <- plyr::ldply(list.files("./data/Hahne2/allcsv", full.names = T, include.dirs = T), read_csv_filename)

## strip the rest of the filename from the columns to make the code column, then make lowercase
import_speechdata$code <- stringr::str_extract(import_speechdata$code, pattern = "(?<=allcsv/)(.+)(?=_tag)")
# import_speechdata <- select(import_speechdata, -X1)
import_speechdata$code <- tolower(import_speechdata$code)

# clean information in the day vector

## add +1 to day for PA06A, MO12A as they have no Sunday, add +1 to SE05A-2 as Sunday is -1 because he did it after 00:00
pa06_add_one <- import_speechdata$code == "pa06a"
import_speechdata$day[pa06_add_one] <- import_speechdata$day[pa06_add_one] + 1

mo12a_add_one <- import_speechdata$code == "mo12a"
import_speechdata$day[mo12a_add_one] <- import_speechdata$day[mo12a_add_one] + 1

se05a2_add_one <- import_speechdata$code == "se05a-2"
import_speechdata$day[se05a2_add_one] <- import_speechdata$day[se05a2_add_one] + 1


## remove Saturdays from the speech dataset (day = 6)
import_speechdata %<>% filter(day != 6)

## add +1 to day to make it parallel with the self-report data
import_speechdata$day <- import_speechdata$day + 1

## -1 for what is now day 8 to make Sunday (8) to Sunday (7) again 
make_sunday_parallel <- import_speechdata$day == 8
import_speechdata$day[make_sunday_parallel] <- import_speechdata$day[make_sunday_parallel] - 1

# remove the second week from the dataset where there was the experimental manipulation
import_speechdata <- import_speechdata %>%
  filter(day < 9)
```

```{r data-merge}
######################### MERGE the two waves of data collection
# make the column names parallel - first wave is template
data_hahne_speech %<>%
  rename(
    # sci
    sci1_debt = sci1, sci2_moving = sci2, sci3_workpressure = sci3,
    sci4_family = sci4, sci5_health = sci5, sci6_ownpressure = sci6,
    # abf
    abf1_hetzen = abf1, abf2_stoerung = abf2, abf3_nichtkoennen = abf3,
    abf4_nichtverstehen = abf4, abf5_kritisiert = abf5, 
    abf6_unfreundlich = abf6, abf10_unstimmigkeitkollegen = abf7,
    abf11_laengerarbeit = abf8, abf12_leistungunzufrieden = abf9,
    abf13_nichtalleserledigt = abf10, abf15_unangenehmesituation = abf11,
    # other
    stressed = mom1, relaxed = mom2, working_hours_per_week = arbeit,
    workinghours_daily = arb,
    # panas
    panas_p1_aktiv = pan1, panas_n1_aerger = pan2, panas_n2_feind = pan3,
    panas_p2_angeregt = pan4, panas_n3_scham = pan5, panas_p3_wach = pan6,
    panas_n4_nervous = pan7, panas_p4_entschlossen = pan8, 
    panas_p5_aufmerksam = pan9, panas_n5_angst = pan10
  )

data_clean <- bind_rows(data_freden_speech, data_hahne_speech)
data_clean$study <- gsub("[[:digit:]]+", "", data_clean$lfdn)
```

```{r data-replicate-level-two-variables}
# in this chunk we duplicate level two variables that are only measured once
# but have to be available every day
data_clean <- as.data.table(data_clean)

data_clean[, age := unique(na.omit(age)), by = code]
data_clean[, gender := unique(na.omit(gender)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci1_debt := unique(na.omit(sci1_debt)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci2_moving := unique(na.omit(sci2_moving)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci3_workpressure := unique(na.omit(sci3_workpressure)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci4_family := unique(na.omit(sci4_family)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci5_health := unique(na.omit(sci5_health)), by = code]
data_clean[, sci6_ownpressure := unique(na.omit(sci6_ownpressure)), by = code]
data_clean[, profession := unique(na.omit(profession)), by = code]
data_clean[, working_hours_per_week := unique(na.omit(working_hours_per_week)), by = code]
```

```{r data-calc-scale-mean}
tmp <- psych::scoreItems(
  keys = list(
    sci = c(
      "sci1_debt", "sci2_moving", "sci3_workpressure", "sci4_family",
      "sci5_health", "sci6_ownpressure"
    ),
    # we take only 11 abf items that were answered by all participants in all waves
    abf_all = c(
      "abf1_hetzen", "abf2_stoerung", "abf3_nichtkoennen",
      "abf4_nichtverstehen", "abf5_kritisiert", "abf6_unfreundlich",
      "abf10_unstimmigkeitkollegen", "abf11_laengerarbeit",
      "abf12_leistungunzufrieden", "abf13_nichtalleserledigt",
      "abf15_unangenehmesituation"
    ),
    abf_timepressure = c(
      "abf1_hetzen", "abf2_stoerung", "abf11_laengerarbeit",
      "abf13_nichtalleserledigt"
    ),
    abf_socialstressors = c(
      "abf5_kritisiert", "abf6_unfreundlich", "abf10_unstimmigkeitkollegen",
      "abf15_unangenehmesituation"
    ),
    abf_underqualified = c(
      "abf3_nichtkoennen", "abf4_nichtverstehen", "abf12_leistungunzufrieden"
    ),
    panas_pos = c(
      "panas_p1_aktiv", "panas_p2_angeregt", "panas_p3_wach",
      "panas_p4_entschlossen", "panas_p5_aufmerksam"
    ),
    panas_neg = c(
      "panas_n1_aerger", "panas_n2_feind", "panas_n3_scham",
      "panas_n4_nervous", "panas_n5_angst"
    )
  ),
  items = data_clean,
  impute = "none",
  min = 1,
  max = 5)

data_clean <- cbind(data_clean, tmp$scores)
```

```{r data-exclude-participants}
# convert to data table again
data_clean <- as.data.table(data_clean)

# remove participants with less than 18 working hours a week
tmp <- data_clean[, length(unique(code))]
data_clean <- data_clean[working_hours_per_week >= 18, ]
meta$missing$too_few_working_hours <- tmp - data_clean[, length(unique(code))]

# if any voice variable is missing all others are missing as well
# exclude all people who participated on less than four days
tmp <- data_clean[, .(days = sum(!is.na(jitter_tag))), by = .(code) ][days >= 4, code]
meta$missing$audio_less_than_four_days <- data_clean[, length(unique(code))] -
  length(tmp)
data_clean <- data_clean[code %in% tmp]

# exclude persons with missing age and sci
# save the number of missing values for later use
meta$missing$age <- data_clean[is.na(age), length(unique(code))]
meta$missing$sci <- data_clean[is.na(sci), length(unique(code))]
data_clean <- data_clean[!is.na(age) | !is.na(sci)]

# exclude days with missing values
# save the number of missing values for later use
# if one outcome is missing, all outcomes are missing
meta$missing$audio_days <- data_clean[is.na(pitch_median_tag), .N]
data_clean <- data_clean[!is.na(pitch_median_tag), ]
```

```{r data-convert}
data_clean[
  ,
  `:=`(
    # add logarithmic variables (means)
    sci_log = log(sci),
    age_log = log(age),
    panas_pos_log = log(panas_pos),
    panas_neg_log = log(panas_neg),
    abf_all_log = log(abf_all),
    stressed_log = log(stressed),
    # make code a factor
    code = factor(code),
    # convert numbers to days
    day_factor = factor(
      day, 
      levels = 1:7, 
      labels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sun")
    ),
    # recode day to be workday vs. Sunday
    sunday_vs_workday = factor(
      day,
      levels = 1:7,
      labels = c("sun", "work", "work", "work", "work", "work", "sun")
    )
  )
]
```

```{r data-center-variables}
# person- and grand-mean centering 
# (gmc = grand-mean centering, pm = person mean, pmc = person-mean centering, pm_gmc = person-mean centering grand-mean centered)

# select variables
tmp <- c(
  "speechrate_tag",
  "pitch_median_tag",
  "pitch_sd_tag",
  "intensity_median_tag",
  "harmonicity_tag",
  "jitter_tag",
  "shimmer_tag",
  "abf_all",
  "abf_timepressure",
  "abf_socialstressors",
  "abf_underqualified",
  "stressed",
  "relaxed",
  "panas_pos",
  "panas_neg",
  "workinghours_daily",
  "age",
  "sci",
  "sci_log",
  "age_log",
  "panas_pos_log",
  "panas_neg_log",
  "abf_all_log",
  "stressed_log"
)


for (item in tmp) {
  # create shortcuts
  item_gm <- paste0(item, "_gm")
  item_gmc <- paste0(item, "_gmc")
  item_pm <- paste0(item, "_pm")
  item_pmc <- paste0(item, "_pmc")
  item_gmc_z <- paste0(item, "_gmc_z")
  item_pm_z <- paste0(item, "_pm_z")
  item_pmc_z <- paste0(item, "_pmc_z")

  # first, create a grand mean (mean of means)
  gm <- data_clean[
    , .(m = mean(get(item), na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(code)
    ][
    , mean(m, na.rm = TRUE)
    ]

  # save grand mean and center around weighted grand mean
  data_clean[, (item_gm) := gm]
  data_clean[, (item_gmc) := get(item) - gm, .SDcols = item]

  # create a person mean and save it (based on weighted grand mean)
  data_clean[, (item_pm) := mean(get(item_gmc), na.rm = TRUE), by = .(code)]

  # center around person mean
  data_clean[, (item_pmc) := get(item_gmc) - get(item_pm)]

  # standardise variables
  data_clean[, (item_gmc_z) := scale(get(item_gmc))[, 1]]
  data_clean[, (item_pm_z) := scale(get(item_pm))[, 1]]
  data_clean[, (item_pmc_z) := scale(get(item_pmc))[, 1]]
}

write.csv(data_clean, "./data/data_clean.csv")
```
